data.offering_description: Online health insurance marketplace that helps individuals, families and Medicare beneficiaries compare and enroll in plans from insurance carriers. Licensed agents assist by phone and online, and carriers pay commissions on enrolled policies.

data.primary_products: Medicare plans; individual and family health plans; life insurance; dental and vision plans

data.primary_services: insurance plan enrollment assistance; licensed agent advice; plan comparison

data.customer_segment: B2C: Medicare beneficiaries, individuals and families buying health and life insurance; B2B: insurance carriers that pay commissions on enrolled policies

data.end_markets: health insurance; life insurance; senior health

data.revenue_model: commissions or management fees: carrier commissions paid for each enrolled insurance policy

data.value_chain_position: financial intermediary: sells carrier policies to consumers, paid by carriers, sold to insurance carriers and consumers; software / platform: online comparison and enrollment platform for consumers and agents

data.geography_served: US national: all 50 states through carrier networks

data.specialization: related lines: Medicare, individual and family health, life, dental and vision plans sold through shared agents and platform

data.distribution_channels: online: website for consumers to compare and enroll in plans; direct sales: licensed agents selling by phone to consumers; agents / brokers: licensed insurance agents placing policies with carriers

data.regulatory_exposure: high: insurance producer licensing by state regulators, Medicare marketing rules from CMS, HIPAA and telemarketing rules

data.offering_description: Operates an online and phone-based marketplace where individuals, families and small businesses compare and enroll in health insurance, especially Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement and Part D plans. It earns commissions from insurance carriers through licensed agents, a technology platform and consumer websites.

data.primary_services: health insurance enrollment brokerage; Medicare plan comparison and enrollment; individual and family plan enrollment; small business health plan enrollment; marketing and technology services for carriers

data.customer_segment: B2C: Medicare-eligible seniors, individuals and families buying health insurance; B2B: Small businesses and insurance carriers paying for enrollment and marketing services

data.end_markets: health insurance; Medicare; senior healthcare coverage

data.revenue_model: commissions or management fees: commissions from insurance carriers on policies sold, including renewals; service fees: marketing and technology fees from carriers and partners

data.value_chain_position: financial intermediary: licensed insurance broker selling carrier plans to consumers and small businesses; software / platform: online marketplace and enrollment technology platform

data.geography_served: US national: Licensed to sell in all US states and DC

data.specialization: related lines: Medicare plans, individual and family plans, small business plans, and carrier technology services

data.distribution_channels: online: consumer websites and online enrollment platform; direct sales: licensed agents enrolling customers by phone; partners / resellers: partner and affiliate websites and lead sources

data.regulatory_exposure: high: Insurance broker licensing by state regulators, CMS Medicare marketing rules, ACA rules, HIPAA and telemarketing rules

data.offering_description: Sells property, casualty, and employee benefits insurance placed with carriers to businesses and individuals through brokerage, wholesale, and program administration; earns commissions and service fees from clients and insurance carriers.

data.primary_services: insurance brokerage; wholesale brokerage; program administration; risk management consulting; claims advocacy

data.customer_segment: B2B: commercial clients, including businesses, nonprofits and public-entity-adjacent organizations; B2C: individuals and families buying personal lines insurance

data.end_markets: construction; real estate; hospitality; healthcare; manufacturing; personal insurance

data.revenue_model: commissions or management fees: commissions from insurance carriers on policies placed, and program management fees; service fees: fees for risk consulting, claims advocacy and administration

data.value_chain_position: financial intermediary: places insurance coverage, taking commissions from carriers and selling to businesses and individuals; service provider: provides risk consulting, claims handling and program administration to clients and agencies

data.geography_served: US national: offices and clients across many US states

data.specialization: related lines: retail and wholesale insurance brokerage, program administration, and personal lines, sharing carrier relationships and expertise

data.distribution_channels: direct sales: producers selling insurance to commercial and personal clients; own locations: branch offices across the US; partners / resellers: independent agencies served through wholesale and program arrangements

data.regulatory_exposure: high: insurance producer licensing and carrier appointments under state insurance departments, plus federal and state insurance rules

data.offering_description: Independent insurance distributor (formerly BRP Group) that places commercial, personal risk, employee benefits and specialty insurance with carriers for businesses and individuals. It also provides underwriting, managing general agency and consulting services through its agencies and underwriting and technology platform.

data.primary_services: commercial insurance brokerage; personal risk and homeowners insurance placement; employee benefits consulting; managing general agency and underwriting services; insurance technology and program solutions

data.customer_segment: B2B: businesses of all sizes buying property-casualty coverage and employee benefits; B2C: individuals and families buying home, auto, life and health insurance

data.end_markets: commercial insurance; personal insurance; employee benefits; specialty insurance; real estate and construction

data.revenue_model: commissions or management fees: commissions from insurance carriers on placed policies, plus profit-sharing contingent commissions; service fees: consulting and advisory fees for benefits and risk management

data.value_chain_position: financial intermediary: places coverage from insurance carriers for commercial and individual clients as broker and managing general agent; software / platform: technology and data platform supporting underwriting and distribution for partner agencies and carriers

data.geography_served: US national: offices across many US states, with clients nationwide

data.specialization: related lines: commercial, personal risk, employee benefits and underwriting/MGA lines all focused on insurance distribution

data.distribution_channels: direct sales: producers and advisors in company-owned agencies selling to clients; agents / brokers: wholesale and MGA programs distributing through independent agents; partners / resellers: real estate, mortgage and homebuilder partners referring personal insurance

data.regulatory_exposure: high: insurance agency licensing regulated by state insurance departments, benefits subject to ERISA and ACA rules

P1.1.text: The Baldwin Group | Insurance & Risk Management

P1.2.text: We offer tailored insurance and risk management solutions for individuals, families & businesses. Empower yourself with peace of mind.

P1.3.text: The Baldwin Group to go private. Read a message from our CEO here.

P1.4.text: Dream boldly, build fearlessly— we’ll help protect it. As a top-ranked national advisory firm, we listen, simplify complexity, and communicate openly to deliver insurance, risk management, benefits, and wealth management solutions tailored to the future you’re creating.

P1.5.text: Reports, headlines, insights, and more—see what’s happening and what it means for you, because staying ahead starts with staying informed.

P1.7.text: A troubled NYC tower reveals how structural surprises and budget overruns are reshaping conversion risk.

P1.9.text: 53% of employees feel overwhelmed by their benefits. See how to turn investment into impact.

P1.11.text: Rising claim severity and shifting coverage availability are influencing how families protect what they’ve built.

P1.12.text: Your goals. Our expertise. Take the next step.

P1.13.text: Personal or business, simple or complex—if you can dream it, we’re ready to protect it.

P1.14.text: Solutions for every chapter of life

P1.15.text: Home, health, wealth, legacy—your life doesn’t fit in a box, so we make sure your protection doesn’t either.

P1.16.text: Insurance needs change as life moves forward—home, auto, Medicare. Protecting it takes coverage built to move with you.

P1.17.text: Establishing your legacy requires deliberate work— collections, valuables, estates. We help you protect it just as intentionally.

P1.18.text: Building wealth takes discipline—investing, retirement, estate planning. Our advisors help you prepare for the long term.

P1.19.text: Solutions built for every stage of growth

P1.20.text: Talent, risk, growth, succession—no two businesses are alike, and neither are the plans we build.

P1.21.text: Growth brings opportunities and new risk exposures. Our specialists prepare you for what’s ahead.

P1.22.text: Top talent expects more than a paycheck. Across health and ancillary solutions, we help you build benefits that keep them engaged.

P1.23.text: A strong retirement plan comes down to the details—design, compliance, fiduciary duty. Our advisors help you get them right.

P1.24.text: A market that won’t sit still

P1.25.text: See how commercial risk, benefits, private risk, and wealth trends shifted at midyear—and what it means for you.

P1.27.text: Every award reflects our commitment to showing up, for our clients and for each other.

P1.28.text: Fortune’s Best Workplaces for Women™ and Fortune’s Best Workplaces for Financial Services™ used under license. Fortune Magazine and Fortune Media (USA) Corporation are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of The Baldwin Group.

P2.2.text: The Baldwin Group: Your trusted partners for insurance advisory services, risk mitigation, employee benefits, and wealth management solutions. Learn more!

P2.3.text: At The Baldwin Group, we translate complex concerns into straightforward, customized solutions to help protect the possible for our clients and enable them to face the future with confidence.​

P2.4.text: The right partners for the right moment

P2.5.text: The Baldwin Group is going private, in partnership with Sequence Holdings and DFO Management, the family investment office of Dell Technologies Founder, Chairman, and CEO Michael Dell. Our vision is unchanged. Our strategy is unchanged. The only thing changing is the capital structure around the firm, and we are changing it because the moment in front of us demands it.

P2.6.text: Every day our clients are pursuing what’s possible, for themselves, their families and their businesses, in a world where risk grows more complex and more connected each year. Our job is to build faster than the risks change. The freedom and the pace this next chapter unlocks will enable us to continue protecting the possibilities our clients are chasing. Read the full message from our CEO.
